# Repository card

`repo-card.png` is the repository's social-preview image (GitHub → *Settings → General →
Social preview*; GitHub accepts PNG/JPG/GIF under 1 MB, recommended 1280×640).
`repo-card.svg` is the vector master. Both are generated by `make_repo_card.py`.

## Regenerate

Requires [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/) (it installs the script's Python dependencies —
`fonttools`, `uharfbuzz`, `resvg-py` — from the inline metadata at the top of the script):

```bash
uv run .github/assets/make_repo_card.py            # writes repo-card.svg + repo-card.png here
uv run .github/assets/make_repo_card.py out.svg    # custom output path (out.svg + out.png)
uv run .github/assets/make_repo_card.py --no-png   # SVG only
```

Text is set in Atkinson Hyperlegible Next, the course typeface, read from the repo-root
[`fonts/`](../../fonts/) directory and converted to outlines, so nothing is downloaded.
The board layout is committed here as well.

| File | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `make_repo_card.py` | Generator: isometric scene, text-to-outline conversion, validation, SVG/PNG output |
| `SE423_F28379D.brd` | Eagle layout of the SE 423 breakout board; its traces, pads, silkscreen and populated parts are drawn from it |
| `../../fonts/` | Atkinson Hyperlegible Next (SIL Open Font License 1.1), shared with the rest of the course material |

## Validation

Before anything is written the script runs ~300 checks and aborts on any failure, e.g.:
objects rest on their supports and do not intersect; arms reach their targets with bent
elbows; every LiDAR return lies on the wall face it hit and the arena walls are taller than
the scan plane; the robot's mocap posts are outside the LiDAR field of view; the A\* path
is collision-free, starts along the robot's heading and ends on the goal ball; the
AprilTag is tag36h11 ID 0; every text colour meets WCAG AA contrast on Illini Blue; the
layout keeps its margins.
